why: No major reviewer or authority appears; the results are affiliate listing-title roundups (several from the same template), one brand product page, a KVM/dock page answering a neighbouring question, and two unreadable pages. Only PicksLab gives a direct, verified pick, and it ignores the SSD/10Gbps part of the question. A page comparing 10Gbps USB-C switches with tested drive throughput, switching behaviour and live prices would stand out.
